outcome: Rejected both wave-mip scheduling candidates. Exact tested output, but no useful repeatable full-frame speed improvement. Restored the accepted headless renderer.

interleaved.sourceAudit: All twelve original per-texture level blocks are text-identical; only their order and collective barrier placement change.

simd.method: The first shared reduction crosses SIMD groups; a whole-group return follows its barrier. One 32-lane SIMD group computes remaining levels through converged float4 register shuffles. Original half conversion boundaries and per-output sum order are retained.
simd.admission: Explicit opt-in; rejected if compiled pipeline threadExecutionWidth is not 32.

implementation.scope: Identical two dispatches, textures, wave cascades, mip dimensions, format, rounding mode, resource bindings and image passes. Barrier counts are source-level collective sites, not measured hardware instruction counts.

interpretation.interleavedDefault: Mean improved 1.32%, median 1.51%, but both versions varied substantially (approximately 6.5-8.6 ms run medians); inconclusive.
interpretation.interleavedStable: Mean improved 0.93%, median 0.22%, p95 effectively unchanged. Not enough repeatable benefit to retain a second production kernel.
interpretation.simdDefault: Mean worsened 1.54%, median worsened 1.85%, p95 worsened 0.51%.
interpretation.cpu: CPU timing varied; no CPU improvement is claimed for these GPU-only scheduling changes.
interpretation.decision: Restore the original nine-barrier fused kernel. Fewer synchronization sites and fewer static shared bytes do not establish a faster complete renderer.

limitations: Only one M1, 24 unprofiled interleaved full-frame runs. Initial measurements were nonstationary; no system thermal/performance warning was recorded, but frequency and other GPU work were not isolated.
Native texture-store rounding was towardZero. RNE-only hardware, arbitrary synthetic input patterns and subnormal/cancellation stress were not separately validated after the performance gate failed.

The dedicated 14-case checks compare real generated GPU data across all wave/foam mips, cloud intermediates, all bloom levels, HDR and final display. They are not a proof for every possible texture input or GPU.
No exact instruction count, register-pressure counter, DRAM traffic, occupancy, power or battery measurement.
Current timings use the windowless runner. They are not direct comparisons against older windowed measurements.

validation.headlessPreservation: All ten source hashes and 28 shader hashes from the accepted windowless-backend report match after restoration. Experimental scripts and shader sources were removed from production and stale experimental bundle shader files removed.
validation.suiteScope: Two dedicated fourteen-case exact comparisons and 24 benchmark runs. Full historical suite not rerun for rejected kernels.
